blurb: The county's flagship park. A large playground with adaptive swings and the fully fenced High5 adaptive sensory playground, shade sails and a shade pavilion, a skate bowl, a promenade, and the busiest public dog park in the state.

name: Rockwood Park
blurb: A Gothic Revival mansion and its grounds, with gardens, lawns and walking paths. Hosts a farmers market. More formal than the county's other parks. This is a stroll rather than a hike.

name: Valley Garden Park
blurb: A hundred-acre du Pont estate garden given to the city in 1942, sitting outside the city limits near Hoopes Reservoir. A paved path along a creek, and in early spring the magnolias and the daffodil bank. That's genuinely it — no playground, no pavilion, no plumbing. Come for a walk and the flowering trees, not for an afternoon.

restrooms.note: A portable unit. Not a plumbed block — the city's amenity list doesn't mention restrooms at all, so this is only here because someone stood in front of it.

hoursNote: The city publishes no hours for this park.
warnings: Outside Wilmington city limits despite being a city park. It's in Greenville.
The only toilet is a portable unit, and no drinking water. Fine for an hour, not for a day out.
outstanding: Get opening hours. The city publishes none.
Confirm whether the portable unit is there year round or only in spring.

Confirm the usual peak week for the magnolias and daffodils.

photos.alt: Saucer magnolias in pink bloom and a white star magnolia beside a narrow stream, with a bench, mown grass and a bank of daffodils behind.
photos.caption: The magnolias over the stream, with the daffodil bank behind. Early spring, which is the week this park is famous for.

fieldNotes.author: Site maintainer
fieldNotes.body: There's a porta potty, a paved path and the creek. Little else — no playground, no pavilion, nothing to fill a bottle from.

name: Delcastle Recreational Park
blurb: The county's big playing-field park off Duncan Road: baseball, soccer, football, tennis, basketball and street hockey, with paved trails, a fitness circuit and woods around the edge. Free to walk into; you only pay if you're booking a field.

restrooms.note: Listed on the county's own amenity list for this park.
